description: This file declares the API functions related to the Dslh Object Entity component, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions. It is part of a DSL Home Model implementation, providing external interface prototypes.

methods.name: DslhCreateObjEntity
methods.description: Creates an Object Entity instance with provided container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: DslhObjeoCreate
methods.description: Creates an Object Entity object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: DslhObjeoRemove
methods.description: Removes an Object Entity object identified by the given handle.

methods.name: DslhObjeoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary sub-objects or components for the Object Entity.

methods.name: DslhObjeoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes an Object Entity object to ready it for use.
